title: UI receipt handoffs, planned systems and source-census boundary
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: partial actual contract review; actual transactions and enabling producers distinguished from proposed interfaces/census
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual new review covers original326–625: MC26 continuation, MC27–MC58, round4 planned/enabling systems and round5 source-tier/census introduction through its first book row. B562–B563 cover original1–625 only. Original626–1174 and appended notes remain. No registry, extracted-record corpus, underlying source, current code or picture is newly inspected merely because this receipt names it.

F2: MC26–MC40 preserve existing actual storage/trade/workshop/loadout transaction semantics while proposing useful handoffs. Inspect/open/commit differ; exact holder/item/lot, quote freshness, result identity, units/baseline and return stack matter. Loadout partial application must not be displayed as atomic storage transfer. Historic completion link is not collection or a new grant. Unknown versus no-data/filter/known-unavailable needs admitted facts, not fake locked content/counts. A source-level candidate (destination-only fastest-route collapse, disabled Open-owed fallback or a source-less study bridge) is not a newly reproduced runtime defect. Existing comparison, native reviews and known-route checks prevent proposing them as wholly absent.

F3: MC41–MC54 retain actual contract duration, payer/beneficiary, kit custody, teacher time/terms, reserve/output/control/strain, exposure/query result, object concealment, legal allegation/evidence, site phase, finite mandate, growing creature and inherited estate as distinct mechanisms. No new global mana/attention/wanted/hunger/reputation meter follows. A paid/inconclusive assay changes attributed knowledge, not the object's full identity or ownership. Stronger faculty may know more or bypass ordinary means under AD38. Quiet/passive cheat does not require an activation panel; qualitative story lean is not a measured probability, and player configuration is not character omniscience.

F4: Existing management, household, brood, energy/divination and continuation modules are historical inspected producers with bounded contracts, not all-life proof. Source presence/registration differs from current reachable entry and persistence. Free worker now is not future availability; dispatch is not delivered result; household resources are not automatically personal money; a body stage/parent relation is not ownership of every future benefit. Actual site retreat preserves its local installed support/custody, and unobserved completion does not grant every observer knowledge. Do not turn planned rent/legal/search/automation into mandatory prerequisites or copy Village pay/fuel/time into every book.

F5: MC55–MC58 public support rows and agreed-term/causal reference views can reuse existing quote/job/receipt/observer owners. They cannot reserve/release stock, recompute contracts or invent a cause/hidden motive. Failed storage, changed support and stale terms need the owning actual policy; UI not a second store. AD51 qualifies old repeated-consumer-before-extraction wording, AD42/AD36/AD43 current review/proof. Frontier/Mistglass retain current test-bed scope; old L2b queue labels are historical, not blanket present blockers. Suggested bounded consumer order is proposal, not changed priority or runtime dispatch.

F6: Round5's152 keys/44 groups/42058 distinct(id,locator) rows/253 candidates describe a historical scan and extraction sample, not verified facts, chapter reads or a whole-library census. Missing direct-path rules in28 groups is not absence of other sources or proof unread. Reader labels remain attributed; selected source paragraphs still need qualification. The remaining book table has not yet been read in this tranche. No new research wave, acquisition, private artifact/save, source/code/build/browser, worker/message, migration, deletion, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Actual original326–625 read in four bounded untruncated outputs. B562 actual1–325; no linked supplier/source credit.
reviews.reopen: Continue original626–1174 and appended notes; source table/remainder not reviewed by count.
